breakfast.name: Bibimbap (Mixed Rice)
breakfast.description: Rice topped with vegetables, egg, meat, and gochujang sauce, mixed together before eating
instructions: Cook beef in skillet, set aside
Blanch spinach, squeeze dry, season with sesame oil
Arrange vegetables, beef, kimchi on top
Make indent in center, add raw egg (or fried)
Drizzle with sesame oil and gochujang mixed with water
breakfast.notes: Each ingredient should be cooked separately and arranged artfully
breakfast.fun_fact: Bibimbap is a complete meal with vegetables, protein, rice, and sauce

lunch.name: Bulgogi (Marinated Beef)
lunch.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in sweet-salty sauce, grilled at table in Korean BBQ style
instructions: Make marinade with soy, sesame oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic, ginger
Marinate beef 30 minutes (or up to 4 hours)
Heat cast iron skillet or grill pan to very hot
Cook beef in batches until edges caramelize (1-2 min per side)
Serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping
Top with sesame seeds and scallions
Wrap in lettuce with ssamjang sauce
lunch.notes: Beef should be sliced very thin - easier if partially frozen
lunch.fun_fact: Bulgogi is Korea's most famous beef dish

dinner.name: Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)
dinner.description: Spicy stew with kimchi, pork, tofu and broth
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in pot
Add kimchi and gochugaru, stir 2 minutes
Add broth and bring to boil
Season with fish sauce and sugar
dinner.notes: The kimchi juice is essential for flavor
dinner.fun_fact: Kimchi jjigae is comfort food in Korea

snacks.name: Kimbap (Seaweed Rice Roll)
snacks.description: Rice and vegetable-filled seaweed rolls, often called Korean sushi
ingredients: 1 egg, cooked and cut into strips
instructions: Season rice with sesame oil and salt
Place nori shiny side down on bamboo mat
Spread thin layer of rice on nori
Arrange filling ingredients in line across middle
Wet knife and slice into 6-8 pieces
Serve with soy sauce and mustard
snacks.notes: Similar to sushi rolls but with cooked ingredients
snacks.fun_fact: Kimbap is popular picnic and packed lunch food in Korea

desserts.name: Bingsu (Korean Shaved Ice)
desserts.description: Sweet shaved ice dessert with condensed milk, fruit, and red bean
desserts.notes: Ice must be very finely shaved
desserts.fun_fact: Bingsu is popular Korean summer dessert

drinks.name: Sikhye (Sweet Rice Drink)
drinks.description: Sweet fermented rice drink made with malt, served cold
instructions: Dissolve malt powder in 1/2 cup warm water
Combine koji liquid with 2.5 cups water and sugar
drinks.notes: Fermentation process is essential for taste
drinks.fun_fact: Sikhye is traditional celebratory drink served at holidays
alternatives: Korjacha (corn tea) as alternative dessert drink

drinks.name: Soju (Korean Spirit)
drinks.description: Clear Korean spirit, often served with food or in cocktails
drinks.fun_fact: Soju is Korea's most popular spirit and the world's best-selling spirit by volume
